title: did:key — Offline Key Discovery
note: Three ways a verifier recovers a notary's public key with no prior trust relationship, in preference order. did:key is first because it needs no network at all: the public key IS the identifier, so an issuer of `did:key:z6Mk...` can be verified entirely offline. There is no silent fallback from a stronger mechanism to a weaker one.
book_ref: APH Spec: §8.4.3 did:key, §8.4.6 Verifier resolution order
